help.command.agent_side_commands: While /coder or /agent runs, these also work mid-run without stopping it: %s
help.command.file_modes: full, chunked, summary or smart: send the content whole, in chunks, summarized, or picked by relevance
help.command.tips_rewind: Rewind (Esc Esc): on an empty prompt, press Esc twice to rewind the conversation.
help.command_no_options: This command takes no subcommands or options.
help.footer: /help <command> shows a command's subcommands and options · / opens the command palette
help.unknown_command: Unknown command %q. Type /help to see every command.
help.usage.footer: Inside the REPL, /help lists every command and /help <command> details one. Docs: https://chatcli.edilsonfreitas.com
help.usage.forms:
Usage:
  chatcli                          interactive REPL
  chatcli -p "<prompt>" [flags]     one-shot (also reads stdin)
  chatcli <subcommand> [args]      see Subcommands; chatcli <subcommand> --help for details
help.usage.parse_error_hint: Run chatcli --help for the flags and subcommands.
help.usage.title: ChatCLI: a terminal client for LLMs (chat, coder agent, tools, MCP/ACP).
oneshot.flag.agent_auto_exec: In the legacy /agent one-shot, run the first suggested command when it is safe
oneshot.flag.prompt: Run this prompt once, non-interactively (/coder <task> runs the coder)
oneshot.flag.raw: Plain output without markdown or ANSI colors (for scripts and CI)
subcmd.acp: Agent Client Protocol server for IDEs (JetBrains, Zed) over stdio
subcmd.connect: Connect this terminal to a remote chatcli server
subcmd.daemon: Run or manage the scheduler daemon
subcmd.dash: Serve the live telemetry dashboard from its own terminal
subcmd.eval: Run offline evaluation suites, compare against a baseline, gate CI
subcmd.gateway: Chat gateway daemon that answers on messaging channels
subcmd.mcp: Manage MCP server configuration (add, list, get, remove)
subcmd.mcp_server: Expose chatcli as an MCP server over stdio
subcmd.plugin: Plugin supply chain: keys, signing, verification, trust, quarantine
subcmd.server: Run chatcli as a gRPC server for remote clients
subcmd.storage: Inventory and prune local stores, without the REPL
subcmd.tool: Run a built-in tool directly, with no LLM turn
subcmd.watch: Watch Kubernetes resources and feed them to the AI
subcmd.web: Serve the local web UI; a session bound there continues in the terminal
